Create a transparent sprite sheet of SIX full-body cels, exactly 2 rows by 3 columns, left-to-right reading order. Detailed hand-painted 2D chibi wuxia RPG style. REFERENCE 1 is the PRIMARY CHARACTER MODEL, identity, ANATOMY, proportions, costume, camera and rigid hammer design. Copy its compact, stocky chibi physique, LARGE head relative to torso, SHORT thick legs, thick cuffs, broad heavy boots, and large rectangular hammer head. The figure must NOT become a taller lean human when exercising. Do not stretch the neck, torso, arms, or legs. Both hands and the hammer remain at exactly the same physical scale throughout.
REFERENCE 2 is ONLY THE APPROVED MOVEMENT CHOREOGRAPHY. Its taller/slimmer proportions are WRONG for this game; replace those proportions using reference 1. Keep the two-handed action and its sequence, not that figure's physique. Camera fixed, slightly elevated three-quarter RIGHT-facing view as reference 1 in ALL six cels; no camera zoom changes.
The character has red-brown tied ponytail/red ribbons, short beard, purple-brown fur-trimmed coat, red sash, bronze bracers and fur boots. Keep face shape and costume materials from reference 1. Scale of head, shoulder block, upper-arm thickness, forearm-cuff diameter, thigh, shin, boot length and hammer dimensions MUST be identical in all six cels. A change of stance may bend the limbs but cannot lengthen them.
Cel 1: EXACT neutral ready pose from reference 1, wide short-legged crouch, tool held across waist, hammer head on image right. This is the anatomy calibration model.
Cel 2: low sweep preparation from first pose of reference 2: torso turns, tool head low left near knee, wooden shaft across waist, BOTH hands on the shaft. Keep stocky body and short legs.
Cel 3: shoulder load from second pose of reference 2: BOTH hands close together beside right temple/shoulder, hammer head high behind on upper-left of silhouette, elbows bent naturally, torso coils. Head and arms do not enlarge or shrink.
Cel 4: broad forward cross-body sweep from third pose of reference 2: extend BOTH arms as hips turn, hammer head out toward front-right at chest/shoulder height. Keep the SAME short limb lengths and compact torso as cel 1; do not straighten into a tall lanky human.
Cel 5: low opposite-side follow-through from fourth pose of reference 2: two close hands near right hip, long shaft diagonal down-left, head of tool low outside left knee and NOT planted on ground. Weight shifts, torso turns; the physique stays compact and feet stay planted.
Cel 6: return to EXACT SAME neutral stance as cel 1 and reference 1, matching head/body proportions and size.
Only TWO hands per cel, both physically gripping one continuous handle; adjacent grip during the swing, correct connected arms, no extra limbs. The medium-long wooden handle and large metal head retain the size and design of reference 1 across every pose. Two calibration idle cels plus four distinct authored exercise poses, ALL drawn at one anatomical pixel density.
